title: Jr. Grade of Mizoram Legal Service (Legal Officer)
qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Law from a University recognized by Bar Council of India, Actively practicing as Advocate for not less than 3 years
age_limit: Minimum Age: 21 years || Maximum Age: 35 years || Upper age limit relaxable up to 5 years for ST/SC candidates.

title: Registrar
qualification: Master's degree with at least 55% Marks or its equivalent grade 'B' in the UGC 7 point scale from a recognized University/Institute.
salary: Level 14 as per 7th CPC (PB-4: 37,400 – 67,000 with GP 10,000/-)
age_limit: Maximum Age Limit: 56 years as on 10-08-2026.

title: Post Doctoral Fellow
qualification: First class in UG and PG, Ph.D Degree from an Institute of Repute, At least 2 research papers in SCI/ SCIE/ SSCI journals
salary: Rs. 65,000/month in the first year, increasing to 67,000/month
